items.text: Geology career options include mineral and energy exploration, mining support, groundwater and hydrogeology, environmental and geotechnical consulting, geological surveys and teaching, and many roles involve field work in remote areas with an emphasis on mapping, sampling and careful interpretation.
Choose between exploration, groundwater, environment and survey routes, build mapping and field skills and plan higher study where roles expect it.
Verify eligibility and avoid agents promising posts.
